palette.mood: A pale overcast section through the ground: a pale grey-white sky, warm stone and umber strata, one saturated violet cable, a single caution-yellow strip reserved for the number nobody published. Quiet, exact, a little tender, never doom.
palette.divergence: Recorded palettes. 11-06 tangerine office walls, teal desks, mint hero, magenta ink. 11-02 midnight indigo cab, sodium amber, teal stream, magenta stamps. 11-01 moss green slope, storm slate, sulphur key, lantern gold. 10-31 sage and cream chart desk, cobalt sea, graphite pencil, brass, vermilion. 10-29 aubergine dusk, rose violet snow, ember orange. 10-24 orbital navy, ember amber, ice cyan, peat. 10-17 deep navy cutaway in frost noon. The 06-26 film on this same permafrost story: ice indigo cutaway, ochre active layer, coral thaw front. This film is a pale overcast section in warm stone and umber with bone-white ice and a cool white paper, a saturated violet cable hero, pewter instruments, a black and white newsprint separate-study card and caution yellow on one strip of tape. It breaks all three legs of 10-31's cobalt, graphite and cream, and shares no hue family with any other film above. The one deliberate overlap is a thin terracotta thaw line and drop, a minimal-area callback to the 06-26 coral thaw front on the same story, kept to a few pixels of line. There is no ghost landscape and no dotted twin: 'the model adjusts' is two needle arcs narrowing as ribbon segments feed the solver, where 06-26 and 11-01 redrew a ghost. Its signature object is a record ribbon that is printed above ground, fed into a solver, held against three witness instruments, shown as a stub beside a slab, shrunk to a sliver on a century axis and extended as ten long-dashed years.

accent_licence.caution yellow #FFD21F: ONLY the tape over the accuracy dial, on screen from frame 1 of S1 as the hook (the taped dial, top left) and continuously from beat 9 (19.2s) to the end of beat 14 (34.1s), and again from beat 33 (74.8s) until the tear completes in beat 37, never in beat 38 or later. The dial is pewter. Every shot where the taped dial is on screen shows the tape: S2, S3, S8. S12 shows the dial as empty glass with no tape.
accent_licence.violet #6F3DF0: Strand only (body and plug). Rulers, calipers and instruments are steel or pewter.
accent_licence.terracotta #B5583A: Thaw only: the thaw line and the single thaw drop in beats 1 and 2, and they return in S13 where the cold open is revisited, in a few pixels of line. A deliberate minimal callback to the 06-26 coral thaw front on this same story. Never a brand accent, never the oven.
accent_licence.white pulse: Strand's travelling pulse, the beads in beat 21, and every practical light (all white, including the lab oven window).
accent_licence.monochrome separate study: The separate-study card is black ink on cool-white newsprint, with a black border and hatch bars. It owns no hue so it can never fuse with the twin or Strand. Curve = ink, bars = ink hatch on pewter, the NOT THE TWIN tag = ink on paper.
accent_licence.line grammars: Long dashes (14 on, 9 off) belong only to the ribbon's ten extra years and the next cable. A strike-through belongs only to the ROAD FAILURE tag in beat 32 (a solid tag). The MID-CENTURY marker is a solid ink hairline. No dotted ghost exists in this film.
accent_licence.Knot: Compact cluster: paper-white nodes, steel links, ink eyes and outlines. No hue.
accent_licence.record ribbon: The ribbon is paper #F4F6F7 with umber ink ticks (#5C5446) and a black outline. The separate-study card is a slightly greyer newsprint (#E4E6E7) so the two never share a surface.

shape_language.grammar: LONG and ROUND against HARD and RECTILINEAR: Strand is a long horizontal rounded line with a round-cornered plug head, set against the road slab, strata, solver box, plates and tags. Knot is a compact cluster of small circles joined by short straight lines so it contrasts with Strand's long soft line.
shape_language.why: The story is a continuous measurement line under a short test. A long violet line lying under a heavy gray slab is the thesis as a silhouette, and no recent hero is long and horizontal.
shape_language.vertical_frame_rule: Strand is never thinner than 40 px at 1080 wide and its 132 by 116 px plug head is always face-on and fully inside y 440 to 1300 whenever Strand appears. In S7 Strand is drawn on a SCREEN-SPACE FOREGROUND LAYER outside the parallax stack: a trench strip spanning y 1160 to 1300 with the plug face inside it and nothing of Strand's face below y 1300, while only the world (slab, shoreline) scales. The floor-port peeks in S3 and S6 obey the same ceiling: plug face fully inside y 440 to 1300. The second cable in S1 is a plain violet run with no face. Strand appears in S1, S2, S3, S6, S7 and S13 and is absent from S4, S5, S8, S9, S10, S11 and S12 by design.

casting.hero: Strand (NET-NEW, lib/strand.tsx): a violet fiber cable with a white pulse and a round plug head carrying a face. Acknowledged: 10-31 had Pip travelling a cable. Strand differs in silhouette (a long horizontal body with a round plug and a face on the cable itself, not a token riding it), in color (violet on bone-white and umber, none of 10-31's cobalt, graphite and cream) and in business (it wakes, peeks under the tape, feeds the printed line up from a floor port, bends under the tags and looks into the lens).
casting.net_new_reason: Knot (NET-NEW, same file) is the neural network the story is about, a compact angular cluster with eyes, the only shape with no precedent on the shelf.

composition.safe_area: One band rule: plates, faces and hero action live in y 440 to 1300. The CaptionBar owns y 1336 to 1472. Every other band (y below 440, y 1300 to 1336, y 1472 to 1500, y above 1500) is decorative free canvas only, never a plate or a face.
composition.signature_shot: Shot 7: the One-Road Ruler. A caliper span lights on one road slab, the camera rises and the world (slab and long painted shoreline) shrinks until the slab is a pixel, while Strand stays on a fixed foreground layer, 40 px thick with its face in frame. The dial is NOT in this shot, so the empty window is saved for shot 8.
